Armed with her combat skills and a fierce determination to make a name for herself, she sought to put her talents to work, carving out a new life among the mercenaries and sellswords of Almeria. Though the scars of her past continued to haunt her, Lyra remained resolute in her pursuit of justice and redemption, ready to face whatever challenges lay ahead as the co-captain of the newly founded Blade Company.
